A '''Spell of Creature Understanding''' was a [[Dathomir Magic|spell]] that could be cast by the [[Witches of Dathomir]]. It allowed a witch to understand animals. Because animals did not have proper [[Language/Legends|languages]], the understanding was primarily based on emotions. The spell was far easier to cast on domestic animals than wild ones, and wild predators were more difficult to communicated with than other [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="CTD" />
